recommendation.explanationSummary: Broader US tech basket that stays basket-first while diversifying away from a pure Mag 7 concentration profile.

explanationBundle.whatThisPortfolioDoes: Broader US tech basket that stays basket-first while diversifying away from a pure Mag 7 concentration profile. It keeps 1% in AUSD as a yield buffer instead of forcing full equity exposure.
explanationBundle.howItIsBuilt: 99% stays in xStocks across 6 names. 1% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: MSFTx 17%, NVDAx 17%, AAPLx 16.9%. Starts from the pinned US Tech Leaders basket membership. Selects names from the starter basket only. Keeps the basket at 6 names.
explanationBundle.howItChanges: Rebalance only when drift clears 275 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.07% annualized turnover, 11.98 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 99% turnover and 44.65 bps total costs with 1% parked in AUSD.
explanationBundle.whatWouldTriggerNextRebalance: A rebalance only becomes actionable when drift clears 2.8% and the lane is still allowed to activate under current route truth. The repo does not prove an autonomous scheduler today.
explanationBundle.howToReadReplay: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 24.08% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.92%. Treat replay as validation, not a promise of future returns.
explanationBundle.bestFor: Best for someone who wants US Tech Leaders exposure through a curated xStocks basket with a visible 1% AUSD buffer and can accept moderate risk with roughly 17% in the largest name.

currentKnobs.label: Candidate family
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the trimmed starter-only basket shape and lowers the AUSD sleeve so the current local winner can compete with more xStocks exposure.

currentKnobs.label: Starter basket
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes basket membership before weights are assigned.

currentKnobs.label: Selection universe
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Widens the eligible pool beyond the starter basket without changing slot identity.

currentKnobs.label: Holdings breadth
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how many names survive ranking into the target basket.

currentKnobs.label: Starter anchor bias
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the slot anchored to its starter basket even when broader selection is enabled.

currentKnobs.label: Ranking signal
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes which names rise or fall inside the current basket.

currentKnobs.label: Weighting curve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how aggressively higher-ranked names dominate the basket.

currentKnobs.label: Signal power
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Makes the weighting curve flatter or more conviction-heavy without changing the underlying signal.

currentKnobs.label: Cash sleeve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how much capital stays in AUSD instead of xStocks exposure.

currentKnobs.label: Single-name cap
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Limits the maximum weight of one name.

currentKnobs.label: Rebalance trigger
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Skips smaller drifts to reduce churn.
